newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's Jan-Sept cement output rises 0.4 percent.
newsitem.headline: Peru's Jan-Sept cement output rises 0.4 percent.

text.p: Peru's cement production during the first three quarters of 1996 rose 0.4 percent to 2.797 million tonnes from 2.786 million tonnes in the same period last year, the private Association of Cement Producers (ASOCEM) said on Friday.
In September, the country's cement production was 322,911 tonnes, the ASOCEM report said, without giving a comparative figure for 1995.
The biggest cement producer in the first three quarters of 1996 was Cementos Lima with 1.189 million tonnes, followed by Cementos Norte Pacasmayo with 576,180 tonnes.
